data.one_liner: Flutter analog and digital clock plugin for custom clock widgets.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable analog and digital clock widgets for Flutter applications. Supports live updating, multiple styling parameters, and date/time formatting options.
use_when: You need to display a customizable analog or digital clock in your UI.
You want live-updating clocks with custom hand, number, and decoration colors.
avoid_when: You need complex date/time utilities or parsing rather than UI clock widgets.
strengths: Supports both analog and digital clock interfaces
Fully customizable appearance including colors, decorations, and numbers
Cross-platform support for Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Limited to clock display widgets rather than full time management or calendar solutions
data.minimal_example:
AnalogClock(
  decoration: BoxDecoration(
    border: Border.all(width: 2.0, color: Colors.black),
    color: Colors.transparent,
    shape: BoxShape.circle),
  width: 150.0,
  isLive: true,
  hourHandColor: Colors.black,
  minuteHandColor: Colors.black,
  showSecondHand: false,
  numberColor: Colors.black87,
  showNumbers: true,
  showAllNumbers: false,
  textScaleFactor: 1.4,
  showTicks: false,
  showDigitalClock: false,
  datetime: DateTime(2019, 1, 1, 9, 12, 15),
)
